info.title: S2 Parcel & Pricing Service REST API
info.description: Parcel booking, pricing, merchant orders, delivery zones and parcel status. Contract paths are gateway paths.

post.description: Idempotent replay returns 200; a new booking returns 201 and Location. Idempotency-Key is optional, 1–100 characters. Allowed roles: CUSTOMER.

Location.description: Response header emitted by the operation.

200.description: Existing resource returned for idempotent replay or replacement.

403.description: Authenticated caller lacks an allowed role or resource permission

409.description: Request conflicts with current resource state

503.description: Service or required dependency is unavailable

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation identifier. The gateway generates a UUID when absent or blank and returns it in the response header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional booking idempotency key; blank values are rejected.
